thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — opened GH PR #4821 to consolidate invocation examples for function/tool calling and structured output. Mostly examples for Python/Node SDKs + a new 'fallback parse' example. Can reviewers take a quick pass? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :eyes:
samir: On it — I'll scan the Node snippets for API changes. Do we want to keep both promise/streaming examples?
elaine: Prefer both. Streaming example should live in 'streaming' section. Keep the sync example minimal. Also add note about model variants fallback.
caro: I noticed one JSON schema in the PR uses `additionalProperties: false` which may break some tool-call outputs. Can we relax to `true` and add schema examples for partial output?
trent: I'd rather keep strict but add a 'lenient' example. We have customers who rely on extra keys.
elaine: Good call. I'll add a lenient schema snippet and a small paragraph about tradeoffs.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs linter failed on CI — `docs-lint/structured-output` — see https://ci.redwood/4821/build/3
samir: I'll patch the Node snippet import path — currently `@redwood/sdk` should be `@redwood/inference`.
elaine: Thanks. Also need someone to update SDK snippet in the migration guide under /guides/migration/tool-calling.md — link is broken in PR.
caro: I'll search for those links and update. ETA EOD.
trent: For the streaming example, include this pattern:
```js
const stream = client.chat.stream(...)
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```
and show how to abort and fallback to non-streaming.
elaine: Nice. Also add a small test case for the fallback parse so we can catch regressions.
samir: Added unit test in a follow-up commit. PTAL.
elaine: LGTM aside from one wording nit. @caro can you confirm link fixes before we merge? Also add short note about guardrails: 'use schema + prompt example to validate'
caro: Will do. I'll also add a link to the evals repo sample prompts.
docs-bot: Branch protected: needs two approvals & passing CI before merge.
elaine: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If we can get approvals by EOD we'll ship these examples in next release.
